_about: Public-domain Girolamo Zanchi (Hieronymus Zanchius, 1516-1590), Reformed theologian of Strasbourg and Heidelberg, for the Word Hoard: An Excellent and Learned Treatise of the Spirituall Mariage betweene Christ and the Church (Cambridge: John Legate, 1592) and H. Zanchius his Confession of Christian Religion (Cambridge: John Legat, 1599), from Internet Archive scans of Early English Books. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

zanchi-spirituall-mariage-1592: An Excellent and Learned Treatise, of the Spirituall Mariage betweene Christ and the Church, and every Faithfull Man, written in Latine by H. Zanchius and translated into English (Cambridge: John Legate, 1592)
zanchi-confession-1599: H. Zanchius his Confession of Christian Religion, which now at length being 70 yeares of age he caused to bee published, Englished (Cambridge: John Legat, 1599)

_excluded.zanchi-other: Latin works (De Religione Christiana 1605, the Miscellanea 1605 and 1608, the 1592 anti-Arian tract); the discourse taken out of Zanchius in Perkins's Case of Conscience (1592, Perkins's book)
